lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Discrete vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of spots, creating a grid-like configuration of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least two prominent longitudinal ridges on the upper flank displaying a sharp vertical gradient transition from illuminated upper facets to shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Scattered distribution of high-luminance blobs visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin silhouette located at the upper-left of the frame.

other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity surface light caustics creating a dynamic network of light lines across the dorsal and upper-lateral skin surfaces, and the presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remoras) on the ventral-lateral region.
